people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
translations.bsb: You must not exploit or oppress a foreign resident, for you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
translations.asv: And a sojourner shalt thou not wrong, neither shalt thou oppress him: for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
